entry: Synthetic worked example - no real participants, quotations or findings
How novice data analysts describe uncertainty when debugging notebook outputs
How do purposively selected novice data analysts describe and manage uncertainty while debugging unexpected notebook outputs?
One participant account and its analytically relevant episodes, not one statement counted as an independent observation.
Illustrative purposive sample of 12 novice analysts in one teaching context; no statistical prevalence claim and no case-study claim.
Constant comparison across accounts, deliberate search for negative cases and reflexive comparison between early and revised interpretations.
Novice analysts generally trust automated notebook outputs.
